lines: Your line is on the roll of this gang, and I am Wuleen-Sei, who keeps it. I add months to the roll for every meal a hand eats.
Ux-Xeek called your line, and it has no name on it. What name do I write?

infos.prompt: Put down the name I carry.
lines: Then your line has a name now, and it is written.
Go up the stairs and out by the door to the pier. We walk along the dock to the families' camp, where the dock meets the land.
Then your line stays blank, with no name on it.
Then go up the stairs and out on the pier. The gang is going to the camp at the dock's landward end.

infos.prompt: Do what you like with your roll.
lines: Then I write nothing, and your line stays blank.
Get up the stairs and out on the pier. You go to the camp with the rest of the gang.
It is mine. I am Buys-The-Months, the broker. Every hand on it owes months to me.
I hire the gang out to unload the lighters at this dock, the boats that bring the ships' goods in to it.
Your place on the roll is mine, whatever stands on your line.
It is mine. I am Buys-The-Months, the broker. Every hand on it owes months to me.
I hire the gang out to unload the lighters at this dock, the boats that bring the ships' goods in to it.
Your place on the roll is mine, and Wuleen-Sei has not finished with your line. Answer her in the hold.
I am Ux-Xeek, port hand of this barge. I call the names in the hold every day, in order. I have never lost one.

infos.prompt: Why is your colour so thin?
lines: I was kept from my Hist for years. My colour thinned and my markings went soft.

Finds-The-Other-Bank is thinned the same way. The gang families keep a cutting from the Hist at Nine Bends at their camp, and it is the nearest I can stand to a Hist. I mean to stand beside it before my colour is gone.
